constraintsManagement.title: Constraints management
constraintsManagement.subtitle: Configure global scheduling rules. Changes are saved to the server.

formHints.maxDailyLectures: Maximum lectures per instructor per day

constraintDescriptions.no_instructor_overlap: Avoid assigning an instructor to two classes at the same time.
constraintDescriptions.no_room_overlap: Avoid assigning the same room to overlapping classes.
constraintDescriptions.room_capacity: Ensure room seats cover enrolled students.
constraintDescriptions.lab_for_lab: Place lab sessions in lab-capable rooms only.
constraintDescriptions.working_hours: Keep sessions inside configured working hours.
constraintDescriptions.max_daily_lectures: Prefer schedules that respect the maximum lectures per instructor per day.
constraintDescriptions.instructor_availability: Only place sessions when the instructor has marked availability.
constraintDescriptions.capacity_threshold: Apply rules when room occupancy approaches the configured threshold.
constraintDescriptions.instructor_pref: Prefer instructor availability and time choices.
constraintDescriptions.load_balance: Distribute teaching load fairly across staff.
constraintDescriptions.student_gap: Reduce large gaps between student classes.
constraintDescriptions.avoid_back_to_back: Keep a break between consecutive instructor lectures.
constraintDescriptions.morning_preference: Prioritize scheduling classes in morning slots when possible.
constraintDescriptions.department_proximity: Keep department courses scheduled on nearby days.
constraintDescriptions.match_type: Keep each course in the correct room type.
constraintDescriptions.room_proximity: Group department sessions in nearby rooms/buildings.
constraintDescriptions.avoid_floor_scatter: Avoid consecutive sessions on different floors.
constraintDescriptions.equipment_match: Ensure required equipment exists in selected rooms.
constraintDescriptions.max_occupancy_threshold: Respect the configured maximum room occupancy ratio.

errors.invalidForm: Please fix invalid settings (time ranges, numeric bounds, and min/max load values).
